name: Keshav Nagar
civicNote: Merged into PMC in 2017 as the remaining part of Mundhwa.
summary: A developing residential area in the Mundhwa belt of east Pune, across from Kharadi and next to Amanora in Hadapsar.
knownFor: Large new residential projects in the Mundhwa-Keshav Nagar belt
Located between Kharadi and Amanora Park Town
connectivity: Keshavnagar-Kharadi bridge, about 411 m long, opened Aug 2026
Railway underbridge links Keshav Nagar towards Amanora
suits: Professionals working in Kharadi or Hadapsar who want newer housing projects.
